title: ConLID: Supervised Contrastive Learning for Low-Resource Language Identification

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing language identification (LID) performance metrics (F1 score, False Positive Rate) between high-resource and low-resource languages to evaluate disparities in recognition accuracy.

Measuring the out-of-domain generalization performance of models trained on narrow, domain-specific data (e.g., religious texts like the Bible) by evaluating them on diverse out-of-domain datasets (e.g., UDHR, FLORES-200).
